verdict.rationale: Graphite documents first-party natural-language interfaces. Agents take plain-language descriptions of what to build or fix and open a draft PR. Graphite Chat lets users ask about PR changes, request and apply fixes, diagnose failing checks, and make edits from chat. GT MCP lets AI agents drive stacked-PR creation. Missing for 10: evidence that core product operations (stack management in the CLI, merge queue, settings) can be driven by natural language rather than only PR-level code changes and review, and independent hands-on corroboration of these natural-language features.
